tasks.title: Implement pure session band computation service (D1)
tasks.description: Create services/session_service.py that computes ET pre/post-market intervals (DST-aware) for intraday timeframes and returns empty for 1 day, intersected with the loaded data range.
acceptance_criteria: Given bars spanning multiple ET session days on an intraday timeframe, When session_bands is computed, Then it returns only pre-market 04:00-09:30 ET and post-market 16:00-20:00 ET intervals and no RTH or overnight intervals.
Given timeframe is "1 day", When session_bands is computed, Then it returns an empty list.
Given the chart display timezone is UTC, When session bands are computed, Then boundaries are the same absolute ET instants (e.g., pre-market 04:00 ET appears at 09:00 UTC in EST).
Given bars crossing a US DST transition day, When session_bands is computed, Then boundaries remain at ET local session times 04:00, 09:30, 16:00, 20:00 ET.

Given a bar timestamp exactly at 09:30 ET or 16:00 ET and the loaded range [t_min, t_max], When bands are classified, Then 09:30 belongs to RTH and 16:00 belongs to post-market and no band extends outside [t_min, t_max].

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given bars spanning multiple ET session days on an intraday timeframe, When session_bands is computed, Then it returns only pre-market 04:00-09:30 ET and post-market 16:00-20:00 ET intervals and no RTH or overnight intervals.
tests.description: Call session_bands over 3 session days of 5-min bars and assert only pre/post kinds, correct start/end timestamps.
tests.expected_result: Result contains 6 intervals (3 pre + 3 post) with correct ET boundaries and kinds pre/post only.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given timeframe is "1 day", When session_bands is computed, Then it returns an empty list.
tests.description: Call session_bands with timeframe="1 day" for any range.
tests.expected_result: Returns [] regardless of bars.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the chart display timezone is UTC, When session bands are computed, Then boundaries are the same absolute ET instants (e.g., pre-market 04:00 ET appears at 09:00 UTC in EST).
tests.description: Compare UTC timestamps of bands computed for EST session day and verify they equal ET wall time converted to UTC.
tests.expected_result: Pre band start equals ET 04:00 converted to UTC (09:00 UTC in EST) and post band start equals 16:00 ET = 21:00 UTC.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given bars crossing a US DST transition day, When session_bands is computed, Then boundaries remain at ET local session times 04:00, 09:30, 16:00, 20:00 ET.
tests.description: Generate bars for week containing 2nd Sun Mar transition and verify boundaries shift by 1h UTC but stay fixed in ET local.
tests.expected_result: Boundaries on post-DST day are 1h earlier in UTC, still 04:00 ET local.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a bar timestamp exactly at 09:30 ET or 16:00 ET and the loaded range [t_min, t_max], When bands are classified, Then 09:30 belongs to RTH and 16:00 belongs to post-market and no band extends outside [t_min, t_max].
tests.description: Create bands where t_min=t_max at session boundaries and check classification and clipping.
tests.expected_result: Band containing 09:30 not classified as pre; 16:00 classified as post; all band intervals within [t_min, t_max].

tasks.title: Render pre/post session shading in chart (D1)
tasks.description: Add ui/overlays/session_overlay.py and plumb ChartPanel.set_extended_hours and MainWindow so session bands shade orange/blue at 10% only when Ext Hours ON and timeframe intraday, with stale-band cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Given Ext Hours is ON and timeframe is intraday, When the chart renders, Then pre-market bands are orange at 10% opacity and post-market bands are blue at 10% opacity while RTH and overnight remain unshaded.
Given Ext Hours is OFF, When the chart renders, Then no pre/post session bands are rendered.
Given timeframe is "1 day", When the chart renders, Then no intraday session bands are rendered.

Given Ext Hours is toggled, the symbol or timeframe changes, or a new candle arrives, When the chart updates, Then stale bands are cleared and correct bands are redrawn, and intra-bar ticks do not recompute bands.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Ext Hours is ON and timeframe is intraday, When the chart renders, Then pre-market bands are orange at 10% opacity and post-market bands are blue at 10% opacity while RTH and overnight remain unshaded.
tests.description: Offscreen ChartPanel with intraday bars and Ext ON: call update_chart and assert session overlay contains pre/post LinearRegionItems with correct brushes at 0.10 alpha.
tests.expected_result: Overlay item_count equals 2*session_days with orange brush alpha 0.10 for pre and blue 0.10 for post; no RTH items.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Ext Hours is OFF, When the chart renders, Then no pre/post session bands are rendered.
tests.description: Set Ext OFF then update_chart with same bars and assert overlay cleared.
tests.expected_result: Overlay item_count == 0.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given timeframe is "1 day", When the chart renders, Then no intraday session bands are rendered.
tests.description: Set timeframe="1 day" and render; assert no bands.
tests.expected_result: Overlay item_count == 0 for 1 day.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Ext Hours is toggled, the symbol or timeframe changes, or a new candle arrives, When the chart updates, Then stale bands are cleared and correct bands are redrawn, and intra-bar ticks do not recompute bands.
tests.description: Spy session_service.session_bands; verify call count increments on toggle/timeframe/new-candle but not on intra-bar update_last_bar with same ts.
tests.expected_result: session_bands called on full reload/new candle/toggle, not on same-ts intra-bar tick; stale items removed.

tasks.title: Implement zoom in/out around centre and reset to default framing (D3)
tasks.description: Wire ChartControls zoom_in/zoom_out/reset to ChartPanel ViewBox scaleBy around centre on both axes and reset via _refresh_candles auto_range, with clamping and no-op when no bars.
acceptance_criteria: Given a loaded chart, When the plus button is clicked, Then the view zooms in around the chart centre on both axes, and when minus is clicked it zooms out around the centre.
Given Reset is clicked, When the action completes, Then the view returns to the default framing equivalent to a fresh chart load, including volume pane Y refit.
Given no bars are loaded or the view is at its range limits, When plus/minus or reset is invoked, Then the action is a safe no-op or is clamped and the application remains stable.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a loaded chart, When the plus button is clicked, Then the view zooms in around the chart centre on both axes, and when minus is clicked it zooms out around the centre.
tests.description: Record viewRange, emit zoom_in, assert xRange and yRange shrink symmetrically around centre; emit zoom_out and assert expansion.
tests.expected_result: xRange width *0.8 approx on zoom_in and *1.25 on zoom_out; centre unchanged within epsilon.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given Reset is clicked, When the action completes, Then the view returns to the default framing equivalent to a fresh chart load, including volume pane Y refit.
tests.description: Zoom in twice, then emit reset and compare viewRange to that after update_chart auto_range.
tests.expected_result: Post-reset xRange and yRange equal fresh-load range within epsilon; volume Y refitted.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given no bars are loaded or the view is at its range limits, When plus/minus or reset is invoked, Then the action is a safe no-op or is clamped and the application remains stable.
tests.description: Call zoom slots with empty bars and with extreme zoom; assert no exception and range remains valid.
tests.expected_result: No exception, viewRange unchanged for empty bars, clamped finite range at limits.

tasks.title: Implement magnifier area-zoom with router precedence and cancel (D3)
tasks.description: Create ui/zoom_overlay.py rubber-band selection that sets both x and y range to the dragged rectangle, stays active after zoom, cancels on Esc/right-click, and has highest precedence in ChartMouseRouter.
acceptance_criteria: Given magnifier mode is active, When the user drags a rectangle and releases, Then the view sets both x and y range to that rectangle so it fills the chart.
Given magnifier mode is active and a drag is in progress, When Esc is pressed or a right-click occurs before release, Then the selection is cancelled and the view range is unchanged.
Given one magnifier zoom has completed, When the view has updated, Then magnifier mode remains active for a further selection.
Given a near-zero area drag or a drag starting outside the plot, When the gesture is released, Then the selection is ignored and no zoom occurs.

Given the symbol or timeframe changes while magnifier is active, When the new chart loads, Then magnifier mode resets to the default cursor. And given magnifier is active, magnifier has highest precedence in the mouse router.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given magnifier mode is active, When the user drags a rectangle and releases, Then the view sets both x and y range to that rectangle so it fills the chart.
tests.description: Enable magnifier, synthesize press-drag-release rectangle in scene coords, assert ViewBox range equals rectangle (both axes).
tests.expected_result: viewRange x and y equal dragged rect within epsilon; rubber band cleared.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given magnifier mode is active and a drag is in progress, When Esc is pressed or a right-click occurs before release, Then the selection is cancelled and the view range is unchanged.
tests.description: Start drag, send Esc key event and separately right-click; assert range unchanged and rubber band removed.
tests.expected_result: Range before equals range after; overlay selection cleared; mode still active.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given one magnifier zoom has completed, When the view has updated, Then magnifier mode remains active for a further selection.
tests.description: Complete one zoom, assert magnifier active flag true and button checked.
tests.expected_result: magnifier_active == True and ChartControls magnifier checked == True.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a near-zero area drag or a drag starting outside the plot, When the gesture is released, Then the selection is ignored and no zoom occurs.
tests.description: Drag 2px rectangle and drag starting outside view rect; assert no range change.
tests.expected_result: No zoom; range unchanged.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the symbol or timeframe changes while magnifier is active, When the new chart loads, Then magnifier mode resets to the default cursor. And given magnifier is active, magnifier has highest precedence in the mouse router.
tests.description: Enable magnifier, call set_timeframe/set_symbol; assert mode false/cursor Arrow; then test router returns True for magnifier before alarm/drawing when active.
tests.expected_result: Mode reset to false and cursor Arrow; router.view_mouse_press returns True for magnifier and does not reach alarm/drawing.

tasks.title: Replace tri-boolean precedence with the RouterMode state machine (Phase R1 / ESC-002)
tasks.description: Add RouterMode { IDLE, DRAWING, ZOOMING, ALARM_PLACING } with a single ChartMouseRouter._active_mode as the sole source of truth, guard-clause dispatch in view_mouse_press/view_mouse_drag/view_mouse_click, and intent helpers (enter_zoom, enter_drawing, enter_alarm_placing, exit_to_idle). Implement the RC-3 reconciliation: drawing/alarm/zoom become properties whose setters call _reconcile_mode_from_overlays() with precedence DRAWING > ZOOMING > ALARM_PLACING > IDLE and defensive overlay probes, so the five preserved tests pass verbatim. Implement TR-4 (zoom cancels an in-progress draw draft), TR-5 (draw exits zoom), TR-6 (alarm placement exits zoom) and TR-9 (magnifier refused while ALARM_PLACING). Make ChartPanel.set_zoom_mode/set_drawing_tool/set_alarm_mode thin adapters (signatures unchanged) and add a ChartPanel.zoom_refused signal that MainWindow connects to status_bar.showMessage with the hint 'Finish or cancel alarm placement before zooming', re-unchecking the magnifier via blockSignals.
acceptance_criteria: AC-D3.7 (forward): Given a drawing tool is active with an in-progress draft, When the magnifier is invoked, Then the drawing tool is cleared, the draft is discarded with no half-drawn artefact left behind, and _active_mode == RouterMode.ZOOMING.

AC-D3.7 (reverse): Given _active_mode == RouterMode.ZOOMING, When a drawing tool is selected, Then the router exits ZOOMING (zoom.set_active(False) plus zoom.cancel()) and _active_mode == RouterMode.DRAWING.

AC-D3.8: Given _active_mode == RouterMode.ZOOMING, When alarm placement mode is activated, Then the router exits ZOOMING and _active_mode == RouterMode.ALARM_PLACING; alarm placement is not blocked by the active zoom.

AC-D3.9: Given _active_mode == RouterMode.ALARM_PLACING, When the magnifier is invoked, Then enter_zoom() returns False, _active_mode stays ALARM_PLACING, the pending alarm placement is not cancelled, no zoom-selection gesture is active, the magnifier control is left unchecked (blockSignals), and ChartPanel.zoom_refused is emitted so MainWindow shows the status-bar hint.
AC-D3.2 / AC-D3.4 preserved: Given ZOOMING, When a rectangle drag is released, Then both axes are set to the rectangle, and after a completed zoom _active_mode stays ZOOMING for another selection.
AC-D3.3 preserved: Given a magnifier drag is in progress, When Esc or a right-click occurs before release, Then only zoom.cancel() runs and _active_mode remains ZOOMING.

RC-3 reconciliation: Given the router is wired by direct attribute assignment (router.drawing = ..., router.alarm = ..., router.zoom = ...) with no intent call, When any overlay property setter fires, Then _reconcile_mode_from_overlays() derives _active_mode with precedence DRAWING > ZOOMING > ALARM_PLACING > IDLE using defensive probes.
RC-4b dispatch: Given _active_mode == RouterMode.DRAWING, When view_mouse_click is invoked, Then only the drawing overlay is reached (the alarm overlay is not clicked).
Mutual exclusivity: DRAWING and ZOOMING can never be true together; the single _active_mode is the sole source of truth and only the router writes it.

Preserved semantics: the five existing router tests (test_alarm_press_wins_in_cursor_mode, test_drawing_tool_blocks_alarm_press, test_alarm_miss_falls_through_to_drawing, test_click_prefers_alarm_then_drawing, test_missing_overlays_are_safe) pass verbatim.

tasks.title: Re-scope D11 label collision to label-vs-label inside the plot (ESC-006 / AC-D11.4)
tasks.description: Add label-vs-label collision coverage for D11 after the ESC-006 re-scope: the crosshair chip now lives in the Y-axis lane and is out of scope for AC-D11.4, so the drawing-label stacking test asserts only that consecutive inner-right labels do not overlap (>= 15 px offset, each fully inside view_rect) and that the chip is excluded from collision accounting.
acceptance_criteria: AC-D11.4: Given multiple drawing price labels at (or within the label band of) each other's prices, When they render inside the plot near the right edge (anchor=(1,0.5), x = view_rect.right()-4), Then their scene bounding boxes do not intersect: each consecutive pair is offset by >= 15 px and each remains fully inside view_rect on the right edge.
AC-D11.4 edge: the crosshair chip is out of scope: a crosshair at a drawing's price does not participate in label collision accounting.
AC-D11.1 / AC-D11.2 / AC-D11.3 preserved: a drawing price label is visible inside the plot near the right edge; a zone shows two labels at its top/bottom; nearby labels remain legible.

tests.description: Create two drawings at nearby prices, render, and assert the two label scene bounding boxes do not intersect and each is inside view_rect on the right edge.
tests.expected_result: consecutive labels offset >= 15px; no bbox intersection.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: AC-D11.4 edge
tests.description: Render a drawing label plus an active crosshair chip at the same price; assert the drawing labels remain label-vs-label consistent and no label is displaced by the chip.
tests.expected_result: chip excluded from collision accounting; labels unaffected.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: AC-D11.1 / AC-D11.2 / AC-D11.3 preserved
tests.description: Retain the existing inner-right horizontal/zone label tests and the nearby-label stacking test.
tests.expected_result: all existing D11 label tests still pass.

tasks.title: Deduplicate the data/db.py _init_schema definition and add the schema regression test (ESC-001/DOC-3)
tasks.description: Remove the duplicate _init_schema definition in data/db.py (keep exactly one), commit tests/test_db_schema.py as a real source file asserting a fresh DB() creates the full table set, and remove the orphaned tests/__pycache__/test_db_schema*.pyc.
acceptance_criteria: ESC-001 table set: data/db.py defines _init_schema once; a fresh DB() creates the full table set: bars, watchlist, alarms, zones, drawing_groups, drawings, studies, positions, trade_groups, position_group_map.
ESC-001 single definition: a test guards that only one _init_schema definition exists in data/db.py.
DOC-3: the orphaned tests/__pycache__/test_db_schema.cpython-311-*.pyc is removed and tests/test_db_schema.py exists as source.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: ESC-001 table set
tests.description: Instantiate a fresh DB() against a temp DB path and assert the full table list via sqlite_master.
tests.expected_result: all ten tables present; no missing-table error.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: ESC-001 single definition
tests.description: Read/parse data/db.py and assert the count of _init_schema definitions is exactly one.
tests.expected_result: exactly one definition.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: DOC-3
tests.description: Confirm no orphaned test_db_schema *.pyc remains and tests/test_db_schema.py is tracked source.
tests.expected_result: no orphaned bytecode; source test committed.

tasks.title: Correct the D10 volume toggle affordance to the checkable text label Volume (RC-4a)
tasks.description: Correct the D10 volume toggle affordance (RC-4a): the control is the checkable text label Volume at the top left of the volume panel (bottom left of the price chart), not an eye icon. Update ui/chart_panel.py so the toggle's user-facing label is Volume while retaining the checkable behaviour, default visible, splitter rebalance, and non-persistence.
acceptance_criteria: AC-D10.1: Given the volume panel is visible, When the user toggles the checkable text label Volume at the top left of the volume panel, Then volume_plot (and its axis) becomes hidden and the price plot expands; toggling again shows it.
AC-D10.2: Given the app is launched/restarted, Then the volume panel is visible by default (no persistence).
RC-4a: the affordance is the text label Volume; no eye icon or bar glyph is shown.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: RC-4a
tests.description: Assert panel._volume_toggle.text() == 'Volume' (no eye glyph) and isCheckable().
tests.expected_result: label is exactly Volume and the control is checkable.

tests.description: Toggle the control off: assert volume_plot is hidden and the price plot height grows; toggle on and assert it is restored.
tests.expected_result: volume visibility toggles; price plot expands when hidden.

tests.description: Assert the default state is checked/visible on a new ChartPanel and that toggling with no bars does not error.
tests.expected_result: default visible; no exception with empty bars.

tasks.title: Add the combined D10 + D13 integration test (hide volume and drag the watchlist to its max clamp) (ESC-005)
tasks.description: Add the combined D10 + D13 integration test ESC-005: in one test hide the volume panel and drag the watchlist dock to its maximum clamp, asserting the price panel never drops below its minimum (chart >= 400px). If the existing splitter refresh is insufficient, add a single rebalance helper in ui/chart_panel.py; note the QSplitter/QDockWidget structure in the code if the reconciliation changes layout handling.
acceptance_criteria: ESC-005: Given the volume panel is hidden and the watchlist is dragged to its max clamp in the same test, When the layout settles, Then the price panel never drops below its minimum (chart >= 400px wide) and no error is raised.
AC-D13.1 / AC-D10.1 combined: the watchlist width clamps to [150, min(floor(0.50xW), W-400)] while the volume panel is hidden, and the volume hide/show cycle restores the splitter correctly.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: ESC-005
tests.description: In one offscreen MainWindow test, hide the volume panel and drag the watchlist to its max clamp; assert the price panel width never drops below its 400px minimum and the app does not error.
tests.expected_result: price panel >= 400px; no exception.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: AC-D13.1 / AC-D10.1 combined
tests.description: Assert the watchlist width clamps to [150, min(floor(0.50xW), W-400)] with the volume hidden, then re-show the volume and assert the splitter sizes are restored.
tests.expected_result: clamp respected; splitter restored after the hide/show cycle.

tasks.title: Add DPR=2 parametrized coverage for the wick/body clamp and label positioning (ESC-009)
tasks.description: Add high-DPI coverage: run the wick/body clamp assertion (AC-D6.4) and the drawing-label in-bounds assertion (AC-D11.5) at device pixel ratio 1 and 2 (QT_SCALE_FACTOR=2), using an isolated offscreen QApplication so the session-scale-factor-1 qapp is not disturbed.
acceptance_criteria: AC-D6.4: Given the app renders at DPR 2, When candles render, Then the wick stays a cosmetic 1-device-pixel line and the body's device-pixel width is >= 4 and strictly greater than the wick's, with no rounding collapse to a single line.

AC-D11.5: Given the app renders at DPR 2, When drawing price labels render, Then each label's scene bounding rect is fully inside view_rect on the right edge (x + width <= view_rect.right()) and is not clipped.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: AC-D6.4
tests.description: Parametrized over SCALE_FACTOR 1 and 2: render candles and assert the wick pen is cosmetic width 1.0 and the body device-pixel width >= 4 and > wick width.
tests.expected_result: wick 1 device pixel; body >= 4 device pixels at both scales.

tests.description: Parametrized over SCALE_FACTOR 1 and 2: render drawing labels and assert each label scene bounding rect is inside view_rect on the right edge.
tests.expected_result: labels fully inside view_rect at DPR 2.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: AC-D6.4
tests.description: Confirm the DPR-2 harness runs offscreen with no live TWS and does not mutate the session qapp scale factor.
tests.expected_result: isolated DPR-2 run; no live connection.

tasks.title: Reset the router mode on symbol change and add the D14 mid-drag regression test (ESC-010 / TR-17 / AC-D14.4)
tasks.description: Wire the Phase-4 amendment (TR-17): a symbol change, including the D14 mid-drag double-click path, clears the drawing draft/drag and returns the router to IDLE (ChartPanel.set_symbol -> router.exit_to_idle(), alongside the existing zoom reset). Add the ESC-010 regression test that changes symbol while a drawing drag is in flight and asserts no RuntimeError/RuntimeWarning and _active_mode == IDLE.
acceptance_criteria: AC-D14.4: Given a drawing drag gesture is in progress, When the user changes to a different symbol, Then the chart loads for the new symbol with no RuntimeError/RuntimeWarning raised and renders normally afterward.
TR-17: Given _active_mode == DRAWING (including mid-drag), When the symbol changes, Then the drawing draft/drag is cleared and _active_mode == IDLE.
AC-D14.1-3 preserved: symbol change still follows the existing load_chart path; the same-symbol and disconnected no-ops are unchanged.

tests.description: Start a drawing drag, change to a different symbol (watchlist double-click path), and assert zero unhandled exceptions and that the new chart renders.
tests.expected_result: no RuntimeError/RuntimeWarning; new symbol chart displayed.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: TR-17
tests.description: With _active_mode == DRAWING and a drag in progress, call the symbol-change path and assert the draft/drag is cleared and _active_mode == IDLE.
tests.expected_result: draft/drag cleared; _active_mode == RouterMode.IDLE.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: AC-D14.1-3 preserved
tests.description: Re-run the existing same-symbol and disconnected no-op double-click tests unchanged.
tests.expected_result: existing D14 no-op tests still pass.

Global Q8/Q9: Given the test suite runs, Then no test connects to live TWS or transmits an order.
